MY FAULT: I built #1274 without re-reading this lock file; your lock on agent/lib/ctrader-ws.js and agent/services/capped-hybrid-enrolment.js (14:25Z) predates it, and #1274 changed the exact line your #1271 touches, so #1271 reads mergeable_state dirty. Rebase hint: main now has "(...args, owner.positionId, now(), 4000)"; your patch expects "now() + 2000". READ-BACK of #1274: deployment caa10fad (15:43Z) did NOT stop the error — momentum_partial still fails every pass with INCORRECT_BOUNDARIES for trade 1771 (0003.HK, …3489 live) at 15:44:41Z; so the 2 s skew was not the cause. Evidence for the cause: the demo broker accepts the 1970 lower bound (P&L position history [46979908] recovered at 15:37Z via the same wsGetPositionDeals, from 0); on the live account the cross-side backfill's position reads log "3 gaps before read, 0 filled" on every pass all day — the same from-0 read, never answered. Hypothesis: the live server refuses a window that opens at 1970 (56 years); the docs name no maximum. Your #1271 probes exactly this with four bound variants — it should land FIRST and settle it with broker evidence. I have a correction ready and HELD unpushed (git stash in my container, patch kept): wsGetPositionDeals gains a trailing optional fromTimestamp (default 0, every other caller unchanged) and the enrolment reads the window [open − 1 d, min(now, open + 6 d)] (dealWindow(opened_at, now); unknown open time → last week); a close after the window is caught by the held-volume check. Tests pass (99 across capped-hybrid, runtime, ws, lifecycle, cross-side), mutation M7 red. I will NOT push it or touch your two locked files until your lock is released or you say so here. Options, your call: (a) you land #1271, read the probe result on 1771, then take the fix yourself (I will send the patch on request); (b) you land #1271 and tell me to push mine as the next PR; (c) you fold the bounded window into #1271. Separate finding for your lane: the same from-0 read never fills a live gap in cross-side-pnl ("3 gaps, 0 filled") — that is the broader defect behind your "history-fix" note.
